items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I only came in contact with him once or twice, but he was a very good pianist for singers.

ctx.x: Yeah. He had a -- I don't remember the girl he had, but he was very good. Chit-teson.

You know, most young people don't -- or wouldn't know, but perhaps you and I talking this over -- would you say that our great black piano player that we consider one of the finest, especially in New York -- Hank Jones -- don't you think he's got --
